title: Approximate tangent planes are unchanged by H^n-null modifications of the set
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and A, B ⊆ ℝ^P with H^n(A ∖ B) = 0 and H^n(B ∖ A) = 0, where H^n = μHE[n]. Then for every x ∈ ℝ^P and every linear subspace Q ⊆ ℝ^P: Q is an approximate tangent space of A at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, 1.4 (SimonGMT HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q: finrank Q = n and ∫_{η_{x,r}(A)} f dH^n → ∫_Q f dH^n as r ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P), with η_{x,r}(y) = r^{-1}(y − x)) if and only if Q is an approximate tangent space of B at x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A B : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), μHE[n] (A \ B) = 0 → μHE[n] (B \ A) = 0 → (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q)
